heroHeadline: NDB Reaches $42.9B as Zimbabwe Enters Membership Talks and India Advances Sept Summit Agenda
heroSubtitle: The New Development Bank announced $42.9 billion in approved financing across 140+ projects by Q1 2026 at its 11th Annual Meeting in Moscow, up from $35.7B at end-2024 — the fastest pace of approvals in the bank's history. Zimbabwe formally entered NDB accession negotiations on May 26 after the NDB Board authorised talks on May 15, which would make Harare the first sub-Saharan African NDB member beyond South Africa and Egypt. India's working-group calendar advanced with inaugural Tourism (May 25) and 2nd MSME technology-access (May 26) sessions under the 2026 chairmanship. The September 12-13 New Delhi summit approaches as the bloc's primary institutions expand beyond its political parent structure, even as internal cohesion remains challenged by the FM Meeting's collapse without a joint communiqué in mid-May over the Iran-UAE confrontation.
footerNote: Data sourced from official BRICS declarations, NDB annual reports, IMF, and major international outlets. Source tiers reflect editorial confidence levels.
